fact: The World Bank ICR says the private partners Portugal Telecom and CST (Companhia Sao Tomense de Telecomunicacoes) were to finance US$11.9 million of the ACE submarine cable participation through the STP-Cabo SARL special purpose vehicle, beside the US$13.1 million IDA grant; the ACE consortium is Orange-led and Portugal Telecom is Portuguese.

The ICR describes the ACE cable participation as a public-private partnership structured through the STP-Cabo SPV, in which the private partners Portugal Telecom and CST put in US$11.9 million alongside the government's IDA-financed share, with the grant effective in July 2011.

The ICR says CST, the Sao Tomean telecoms operator, secured about US$5 million of its share of the US$18.75 million STP-Cabo funding from debt and its own funds or cash flow; the document does not name the lender.
